title: Audit direct &mut inner.sessions[..] mutations that skip the session mutation stamp and can escape the delta persist
outcome: Every product-code mutation of a persisted session field is either stamped, so the delta persist collects it, or explicitly proven to be followed by a stamp or a full persist. Unstamped durable mutations are fixed.
acceptance: Each direct mutable session-record access in product code is classified, with file:line, as: stamped in the same critical section; followed by a stamp or full persist on every path; or not persisted state.

Every unstamped durable mutation is fixed through the stamping accessor, with delta-path regression tests on a disposable store (persist a baseline, mutate, collect the delta, reload) for each fixed class; the review pair is clean and the gates pass. A guard or lint is considered so that new unstamped writes are caught.
